title: LogoAI
tagline: AI logo generator powered by Nebius AI Studio
description: An AI-powered web app that generates professional logos from a prompt, with style presets, color and size controls, a public gallery, and per-user rate limiting. Image generation is driven by models served through Nebius AI Studio / Token Factory.

title: ADK Agent Examples
tagline: Google ADK agents running open models on Nebius Token Factory
description: A collection of five agent examples (analyzer, email, sequential, multi-tool search, and job finder) built on Google's Agent Development Kit. Every demo calls open-source LLMs such as Meta-Llama-3.1 and Nemotron-Ultra-253B through Nebius Token Factory.

title: Real Estate AI Agent
tagline: Structured property data extraction with the Nebius Qwen LLM
description: A Python system that scrapes real estate listings and extracts schema-validated property data as structured JSON. It pairs Bright Data MCP for retrieval with the Qwen LLM on Nebius for adaptive, schema-conforming extraction.

title: Review Intelligence Agent
tagline: Cross-platform review analysis with Nebius-served LLMs
description: An agent that collects customer reviews across platforms and generates sentiment analysis and actionable business insights. The LLM-powered analysis runs on Nebius (requires a NEBIUS_API_KEY), with Bright Data handling collection.

title: Pothole Detection (YOLO)
tagline: YOLOv8 pothole detection trained and served on Nebius Cloud
description: A computer-vision project that fine-tunes a YOLOv8 model on a custom pothole dataset and serves inference behind a React Native app. Both training and inference run on Nebius Cloud GPUs (CUDA), with the full training pipeline and server config included.

title: RAG with Nebius + Postgres
tagline: Document Q&A RAG using Nebius models and pgvector
description: A retrieval-augmented-generation service that ingests uploaded documents and answers questions over them, built on FastAPI with PostgreSQL and pgvector. It uses Nebius for the model layer (configured via NEBIUS_API_KEY).

title: DevScribe AI
tagline: Text-to-text writing assistant powered by Nebius Studio
description: A text-to-text AI assistant built with React, TypeScript and Tailwind that handles code explanation, document summarization, and content generation. The AI layer is powered by Nebius Studio, with a live deployment on Vercel.

title: WhatsApp Bot on Nebius
tagline: Minimal WhatsApp assistant on Nebius AI Studio
description: A lightweight WhatsApp chatbot that connects to Nebius AI Studio via its OpenAI-compatible API. It keeps compact conversation memory, supports hot-reloadable personas, and offers group-aware, context-sensitive replies.

title: Nebius AI on Hono + Cloudflare
tagline: Streaming chat app using Nebius models on Cloudflare
description: An example chat application showing how to use Nebius AI models (Deepseek R1, Meta-Llama) with the Hono framework on Cloudflare. It features real-time streaming responses, Zod input validation, and runtime model switching, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

title: LLM Chess Tournament
tagline: Benchmark LLMs at chess using Nebius AI Studio models
description: A benchmarking harness that runs a chess tournament between large language models and the Stockfish engine, ranking each model's tactical play with Elo ratings. It is built with DSPy and requires models from Nebius AI Studio.

title: RAG Cookbook 2026
description: Forty hands-on recipes for production-grade retrieval-augmented generation covering late chunking, reranking, graph retrieval, multimodal and agentic workflows, each with working code and evaluations. The default LLM provider is Nebius AI Studio (switchable, provider-agnostic).

title: Universal Deep Research
tagline: Strategy-driven deep research agent on Nebius AI Studio
description: A research automation system that combines user-defined strategies, web search, content analysis, and LLM-powered report generation with real-time progress tracking. This edition is configured to run entirely on Nebius AI Studio models via their OpenAI-compatible API (FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend).

title: Morphix AI Image Generator
tagline: FLUX.1-dev text-to-image via Nebius AI Studio
description: A text-to-image platform that turns prompts into 1024x1024 images using Nebius AI Studio's FLUX.1-dev model, with NSFW filtering and multi-provider support. It ships a React frontend and Node/Express backend with a live Vercel deployment.

title: Newsletter Agent
tagline: AI newsletter generator on Nebius AI + Agno + Firecrawl
description: An AI-powered newsletter generator that researches any topic and produces well-structured newsletters from the latest web information. It orchestrates Nebius AI for generation, Agno for the agent layer, and Firecrawl for web scraping.

title: AI News Scout (Tavily + Nebius)
tagline: Tavily search + Nebius embeddings AI/ML news brief agent
description: An eight-stage agent that scouts AI/ML news across configured topics and vendor blogs and emits a deduplicated Markdown brief. It uses Tavily for crawl and search and Nebius (Qwen3-Embedding-8B) for the semantic novelty filter that removes duplicate stories.

title: Inferomics
tagline: Pareto-frontier model picker built on Nebius Token Factory
description: A decision-engine POC for AI unit economics that maps custom weightings (accuracy, latency, cost) to find the optimal model for production. It is built exclusively on Nebius Token Factory to evaluate 40+ open-weight LLMs (Llama 3, Mixtral, Qwen) through one unified API.

title: ClawBench
tagline: Coding-agent model router benchmarked on Nebius Token Factory
description: ClawBench benchmarks a coding agent across open-weight models on Nebius Token Factory, scoring each output on quality, cost, latency, and structured-output reliability. It then exports a routing.md the agent reads natively to route each task to the best model.
